definitions.explanation: A person who comes to visit a place, home, or institution. Used in both everyday and formal contexts.

examples.japanese: {訪問者|ほうもんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
⟦{本日|ほんじつ}→本日：09643_honjitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{訪問者|ほうもんしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三名|さんめい}です。
{訪問者|ほうもんしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{記帳|きちょう}→記帳：18809_kichou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Visitors, please sign in at the reception desk.

notes:
A compound noun formed from ⟦{訪問|ほうもん}→訪問：03622_houmon⟧ (visit) and ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Refers to anyone who visits a place, whether a home, office, hospital, or website.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {訪問者|ほうもんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧ — to welcome a visitor
- {訪問者|ほうもんしゃ}⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧ — visitor parking
- {訪問者|ほうもんしゃ}⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ — number of visitors
- ⟦{不審|ふしん}→不審：16934_fushin⟧な{訪問者|ほうもんしゃ} — suspicious visitor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{来客|らいきゃく}→来客：13061_raikyaku⟧ — guest, caller (more formal, often for business)
- ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧ — guest, customer (broader, more casual)
- ⟦{来訪者|らいほうしゃ}→来訪者：24478_raihousha⟧ — visitor (slightly more formal synonym)
